name: Kandy Zipline & Canopy
description: Kandy Zipline & Canopy is an adrenaline-pumping adventure park nestled in the heart of Kandy, offering visitors thrilling ziplining and canopy tours. The park features breathtaking views of the surrounding hills and forests, perfect for those seeking an exhilarating experience. Established to provide locals and tourists with a unique way to explore the area, it has become a popular spot for adventure seekers. Visitors can soar through the treetops, feeling the rush of speed and height as they traverse the canopy.
monsoon_note: Heavy rain May–Aug; mist at high elevations

name: Hanthana Trekking Centre
description: The Hanthana Trekking Centre, nestled in the lush hills of Kandy, offers adventurous treks through scenic trails, perfect for nature enthusiasts. Established as a local initiative to promote eco-tourism, the centre attracts hikers and bird watchers alike. It stands at the foot of Hanthana Peak, offering panoramic views of the surrounding countryside. Historically, the area has been a retreat for both locals and pilgrims visiting nearby temples, making it a significant spot for cultural and spiritual exploration. Visitors can explore the diverse flora and fauna while learning about the region's rich heritage.

name: Victoria Bungee
description: Victoria Bungee, nestled amidst lush greenery in Kandy’s Central Province, offers thrilling bungee jumping experiences that combine breathtaking views with adrenaline-pumping excitement. Experience the thrill of leaping off a cliff into the crystal-clear waters below, surrounded by nature's splendor.
activities: Bungee Jumping, Nature Walk, Cliff View
